factSources.text: With the Sun in Virgo, the core self strengthens through improving what is real, tending the details, and making life work better. You are here to refine without reducing yourself to what still needs fixing.

factSources.text: The Sun describes identity, vitality, creative force, visibility, and the part of life that wants to be lived with purpose. It shows where someone builds confidence, recognizes what gives them energy, and learns to act from the center of themselves rather than from imitation or approval. The Sun moves through all twelve signs once each year and spends about one month in each sign. Its sign describes the style of identity and vitality; its house shows where that life force seeks expression and recognition. As a Virgo Sun, you personify efficiency, practicality, and a focus on service. You’re detail-oriented and often drawn to tasks that involve analysis or helping others. You shine when precision and care are needed, and your work ethic is second to none.

eventsDuringTransit.meaning: Identity meets independence and disruption. The urge to be different and to do things your own way. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Difference for its own sake: eccentricity, instability, shocking others to no purpose. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

Identity meets drive and aggression. Energy, assertion, and the will to act become central to the sense of self. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Action with little temper behind it. Things get done and the drive feels available rather than volatile. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.
